tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen floor: sunset peach paper (light) / game night (dark).

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: type selector track, empty slot background.

tokens.name: surface-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers: cards, search field, breakdown rows. Always with an `outline` border.

tokens.name: surface-sticker-high
tokens.usage: Sticker inside a sticker (− / + buttons, card slot).

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Screen headers, navigation dock, language selector. Always followed by the sunset band.

tokens.name: on-inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse-surface (≥11:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on inverse-surface (≥8:1).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Main text on surface, surface-sunk and surface-sticker* (≥11:1).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and the unofficial notice on surface and surface-sticker* (≥6:1).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Sticker border (2.5px) and offset shadow. The visual signature: every control has it.

tokens.name: outline-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the dashed border of empty slots. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled main action and active state (segment, tab). Turns yellow in the dark theme.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Current selection: active dock item, chosen language, current step, 1st place.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on highlight (10:1).

tokens.name: sunset-orange
tokens.usage: Sunset band; player 2 color.

tokens.name: sunset-yellow
tokens.usage: Sunset band; player 1 color.

tokens.name: sunset-sea
tokens.usage: Sea band; forward button in flows (with on-sunset); player 4 color.

tokens.name: on-sunset
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any sunset-* (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: App errors (camera unavailable, card not recognized). Always with icon and text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
